question: Does identity-relation exclude difference like that between separate selves?
premises: Power stands in a relation of identity with Śambhu.
Difference like that between separate selves implies external otherness.
The text also denies that power is simply stated as different.
inference: Because of identity-relation, power is neither different like another self nor merely declared different.
plain_english: Because of the relation of identity, there is no difference as with another self; thus it is said, nor is it merely stated as different.
